name: hnx_rp4a4_spvm-g2-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-NEXT-ATT4 A1 PRIMARY (next-release HBM die, P = 4; NOT a release element): the SHARED 4-lane PV merge of one BF16 column -- ot_hnx_att4_smerge (one 16-adder FP32 merge datapath, per-lane LV 3 flop rings, events held in the binary counter's free level, residue-static schedule, collision = fault, PUBLISH = 1), every pin registered; STEP 3: turn pre-decoded one cycle ahead (registered one-hot selects per 32-b word, kept copies), reset landed per adder, outline shrunk to util 0.55 of the measured synthesis; replaces 4 x hnx_rp4a4_pvm per column. Critical prefix hnx_rp4a4*: gate + COORD review only, no submit.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hnx_att4_spvm u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/gpu/ot_gpu_fadd.sv rtl/hbm_next/att/ot_hnx_att4_smerge.sv rtl/hbm_next/att/ot_hnx_att4_spvm.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hnx_rp4a4_spvm/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hnx_rp4a4_spvm/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hnx_rp4a4_spvm --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hnx_att4_spvm  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
